column1: # MODE: DEV
# MODE-MANIFEST.tsv -- lists this skill's own files whose install package
# tier cannot be declared with the usual embedded `# MODE: DEV` /
# `<!-- MODE: DEV -->` marker: either the format has no comment syntax to
# carry one (DEV/PROD rows), or the file must never ship at all, in either
# package tier -- a compiler input or a maintainer-only inventory file,
# which an unmarked file's default-to-ship behavior cannot express, and
# which `--package dev` alone cannot express either, since it bypasses the
# marker scan entirely rather than reading it (NEVER rows).
# mode is one of:
#   DEV     ships only in a --package dev build (dev is the inclusive
#           superset of prod, so this is the marker file's usual DEV)
#   PROD    always ships (the usual PROD marker / no-marker default)
#   NEVER   ships in neither tier
# A row whose path ends in `/` is a directory prefix, applying to every file
# under it, so a source tree does not need every file enumerated by hand.
# Read ONLY by src/installer/src/install.rs's own collect_relative_files, as
# an override consulted before a file's own header -- NOT read by
# install.sh/skill_files() or installer/build-release.sh, which already solve
# this same "no comment syntax"/"never ships" problem their own way
# (build-release.sh's listed_by_installer() takes such files straight from
# skill_files() itself; the bash test suite's own unshipped_reason()/exempt()
# functions name rust-migration.tsv and the specific scripts/lib/* files
# below the same way this file's NEVER rows do). This manifest is
# deliberately scoped to the Rust installer only; its entries describe the
# same real files, not a shared source with either bash mechanism.
# TODO: once this pattern is proven out, promote MODE-MANIFEST.tsv from an
# exceptions-only override to the DEFAULT classification mechanism for every
# file (not just the ones a marker cannot carry or express), and retire the
# in-file marker convention for install-tier purposes. Not done yet: markers
# remain load-bearing for installer/build-release.sh's declares_prod() and
# for tests/test-mode-markers.sh's own cross-check, so that is a separate,
# larger migration touching the bash build tooling, not a Rust-only change.
# path
.gitignore
PACKAGE-MAP.tsv
skill-source.txt
